THIS BAIL APPLICATION HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 08.10.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 2025:KER:74533 B.A. No. 12015 of 2025  -:2:-

 ---------------------------------------
 B.A. No. 12015 of 2025  ---------------------------------------
 Dated this the 8th day of Octobber, 2025  ORDER
This bail application is filed under section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS').
2. Petitioners apprehend arrest in Crime No.510 of 2025 of Chokli Police Station, Kannur, registered alleging offences punishable under Sections 498A, 406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The complaint has been filed by the wife of the first petitioner.
3. Sri. Noushad K. A., the learned Public Prosecutor, upon instructions, submitted that the Investigating Officer does not intend to arrest the petitioners, considering the nature of allegations.
4. In view of the above, the apprehension of arrest of the petitioners does not subsist.
Accordingly, the bail application is closed.

Sd/-
BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE jka/08.10.25.
